{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot current prices when price is at support, correcting by 10-15% in first 5-day window",
    "Sentiment turning negative (value < 0) pulls forecasts down 2-3 points faster than sentiment suggests",
    "When price history shows consolidation, model over-smooths variance, creating 0.3-0.5 gap from true outcomes",
    "Underlying trend exists in true outcomes but model responds too slowly to price inflections",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast accuracy only when price is in uptrend phase",
    "Model fails to capture price floor at 68-70 range, forecasting 1-2 points too high in downtrends",
    "Lag effect: model leads actual prices by 1-2 days in trending markets, creating early-positioned forecasts"
] }
